teenKit.tldr: Social media fitness influencers selling 'natural discipline' are often hiding the use of extreme synthetic chemicals like trenbolone, a cattle growth drug that builds impossible physiques while silently crushing heart health.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding the biology behind viral body standards protects you from developing unrealistic body image expectations and dangerous health habits based on internet lies.
keyTakeaways: The human body has a natural muscular ceiling (FFMI > 25.0); pushing far past it requires potent synthetic and often veterinary-grade performance-enhancing drugs.
Trenbolone was originally engineered for feedlot cattle, bypassing normal human enzyme defenses like aromatase and locking onto receptors with brute-force efficiency.

Berkson's Paradox and social media algorithms team up to distort reality, feeding you a non-stop highlight reel of statistical anomalies who claim their physiques come from raw honey and cold plunges.
